headline: B50 Becomes Indonesia's Energy Bulwark, Import Dependence Can Be Reduced
summary: A Koran Jakarta report says the B50 biodiesel mandate can become an energy buffer and reduce Indonesia's reliance on imports. No further details were given in the source.
why: Biodiesel blending mandates replace imported diesel with domestic palm-oil-based fuel, which affects Indonesia's trade balance and palm oil demand.
